rows.note: Transfer credit is held out of this row because a transfer stand-in for the intro course is allowed only by petition from external transfers; the petition is a separate confirm row, so an external transfer student may see this row short.

rows.label: At least 9 credits from the listed upper-level NS courses
rows.note: All six topic lists count together. Transfer credit is held out. Special studies courses and NS 2600 are not on the lists, so they never count.

rows.note: The board cannot see grade mode; confirm each course was graded.

rows.label: Confirm you are not in a DNS major or the Biological Sciences Human Nutrition concentration, which are excluded from this minor
rows.note: Nutritional Sciences and Global and Public Health Sciences are barred in the minor picker; the other excluded programs are confirmed here.
